About me

Hey! I'm Shivansh — a developer who genuinely gets excited about AI stuff. I work at Cognizant building GenAI systems that aren't just cool demos — they're in production, handling real enterprise workloads. LangGraph, RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration… that's my daily playground.

I did my B.Tech in Computer Science from SRM with a CGPA of 9.07, which sounds nerdy — and honestly, it kind of was. But it gave me a solid foundation to actually understand why things work, not just copy-paste from Stack Overflow. I got the GenAI & Data Engineering Achievement Award at Cognizant, which was a nice surprise.

When I'm not staring at terminal output or debugging why an LLM hallucinated again, you'll find me watching cricket 🏏, playing football ⚽ with friends, or deep into a video game 🎮 pretending it counts as "strategic thinking". I'm always up for a good IPL debate or a late-night gaming session.
